formal_conformance.reason: The newest instantiated topic wiki has no .wiki-standard.yaml and explicitly stops at the legacy Level 5 because OKF is absent. Capability evidence below does not silently promote it.

limitations: Graphify and browser runtimes are not fully locked as repository dependencies.

candidate_false_positive_risks.finding: A complete DEPLOYMENT.md must not pass deployment health when the project is explicitly not deployed.
2D/3D publication must not imply local runtime when scripts load unpkg.
Newest implementation and advanced graph/design features must not override the explicit no-OKF Level 5 ceiling.

candidate_false_negative_risks.finding: At audit time, requiring candidate reference 0.0.51 exactly would have rejected the newer, intentionally pinned 0.0.52 implementation; the candidate subsequently requalified 0.0.52.
Keyword checks in one LLM file would miss ingest/query/lint equivalents distributed across AGENTS.md and package scripts.
Custom content/token checks provide lint behaviour without @google/design.md.

recommendations: Add a DenchCo manifest preserving the explicit no-OKF/no-Ask/no-deployment boundaries as states, not inferred waivers.
Generate and validate an OKF v0.2 sidecar if advancing beyond the legacy Level 5 claim.
Vendor graph runtimes and add an offline browser contract; keep Zensical 0.0.52 as an exact project pin subject to compatibility tests.
Complete repository security, copyright/licensing and source-retention policies.
Only mark deployment PASS after the canonical production URL and exact commit pass real HTTP/browser checks.
